data.one_liner: Decode, verify, and generate JSON Web Tokens (JWT) in Dart.
data.what_it_does: JWT_IO allows you to decode JSON Web Tokens, verify their expiration status, get exact expiration dates, and check how old a token is based on its payload.
use_when: You need to decode JWT payloads in your Dart or Flutter application.
You need to check if a token has expired or find its expiration date.
You need a cross-platform solution supporting mobile, web, and desktop.
avoid_when: You need a comprehensive auth suite with social login and OAuth handling built-in.
The package lacks a specific advanced feature documented in newer RFCs.
strengths: Simple static utility methods for easy token inspection.
Supports all major platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Limited documentation and examples beyond basic payload decoding and expiration checks.
Not documented as a full auth manager.
data.minimal_example:
String yourToken = "Your JWT";
Map<String, dynamic> decodedToken = JwtToken.payload(yourToken);
